verdict.rationale: PlanetScale clearly supports programmatic management: the CLI and API can create, delete and list databases and branches, Terraform is supported, and service tokens enable headless automation. Postgres branches are described as isolated deployments, so per-preview or per-agent environments are plausible. However, nothing shows cheap creation at the scale of thousands, and the removal of the hobby tier undercuts the 'cheaply' part of the story. Missing for 10: evidence of low per-database cost or scale-to-zero in the current product, documented support or limits for thousands of databases or branches per org, per-tenant or per-agent fleet patterns, and independent hands-on corroboration of fleet-scale provisioning.
